_description: SENTINEL BMS Intelligence - Cloudflare WAF Rules
_note: Apply via Cloudflare Dashboard or API. These rules are documentation of what to configure.

rules.name: OWASP Core Rule Set
rules.description: Enable Cloudflare managed OWASP ModSecurity Core Rule Set for broad attack protection
rules.rationale: OWASP CRS covers top 10 web vulnerabilities including injection, XSS, and CSRF. Medium sensitivity balances security with false positive reduction for BMS API traffic.

rules.name: SQL Injection Protection
rules.description: Block requests containing SQL injection patterns in query parameters, headers, and request body
rules.rationale: SENTINEL API accepts JSON payloads with equipment IDs, sensor values, and search queries. SQL injection in these fields could compromise Supabase PostgreSQL backend.

cloudflare_config.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "' OR " or http.request.uri.query contains "1=1" or http.request.uri.query contains "UNION SELECT" or http.request.uri.query contains "DROP TABLE" or http.request.uri.query contains "; --" or http.request.body.raw contains "' OR " or http.request.body.raw contains "UNION SELECT")

rules.name: XSS Protection
rules.description: Block requests containing cross-site scripting patterns
rules.rationale: AI chat endpoints accept free-text input that could contain XSS payloads. Block script injection patterns before they reach the backend.

cloudflare_config.expression: (http.request.uri contains "<script" or http.request.uri contains "javascript:" or http.request.uri contains "onerror=" or http.request.uri contains "onload=" or http.request.body.raw contains "<script" or http.request.body.raw contains "javascript:")

rules.name: Path Traversal Protection
rules.description: Block requests attempting directory traversal to access system files
rules.rationale: Prevent access to .env files, system configs, and source code through path traversal. Critical for protecting API keys and database credentials.

cloudflare_config.expression: (http.request.uri contains "../" or http.request.uri contains "..\\" or http.request.uri contains "%2e%2e%2f" or http.request.uri contains "%2e%2e/" or http.request.uri contains "..%2f" or http.request.uri contains ".env" or http.request.uri contains "/etc/passwd")

rules.name: API Rate Limiting
rules.description: Endpoint-specific rate limits for SENTINEL API to prevent abuse and control costs
rules.rationale: Different endpoints have different cost and safety profiles. AI chat is expensive (Claude API), device control is safety-critical, MCP tools need moderate limits.

rules.name: AI Chat Rate Limit
rules.rationale: AI chat calls Claude API at ~$0.01/query. 30 req/min/IP prevents cost abuse while allowing normal conversation.

rules.name: MCP Tool Rate Limit
rules.rationale: MCP tools interact with building systems. 60 req/min allows batch operations while preventing runaway automation.

rules.name: Device Control Rate Limit
rules.rationale: Safety-critical: device control changes BMS setpoints. 20 req/min prevents accidental rapid-fire commands. 2-min cooldown on violation.

rules.name: General API Rate Limit
rules.rationale: General API limit allows normal dashboard usage. Challenge (not block) gives legitimate users a chance to continue.

rules.name: Bot Protection
rules.description: Challenge requests from known bot user agents, excluding monitoring services
rules.rationale: Protect against automated scanners, scrapers, and vulnerability tools while allowing legitimate monitoring (UptimeRobot, health checks).

cloudflare_config.expression: (cf.client.bot and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/health" and not http.user_agent contains "UptimeRobot" and not http.user_agent contains "Cloudflare")

rules.name: Geographic Access Control
rules.description: Allow South Africa primarily, challenge requests from high-risk countries
rules.rationale: SENTINEL manages South African buildings. Primary users are in ZA. Challenge (not block) non-ZA traffic to reduce automated attacks while allowing legitimate remote access.

cloudflare_config.expression: (not ip.geoip.country in {"ZA" "GB" "US" "DE" "NL"} and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/" and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/health")
cloudflare_config.note: ZA=South Africa (primary), GB/US/DE/NL=allowed for remote access and Cloudflare infrastructure

rules.name: Request Size Limits
rules.description: Block oversized requests to prevent DoS via large payloads
rules.rationale: Normal SENTINEL API payloads are <1MB. OCR and vision endpoints accept images up to 5MB. Block >10MB to prevent resource exhaustion.

cloudflare_config.expression: (http.request.body.size gt 10485760 and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/ocr/process" and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/vision/analyze")
cloudflare_config.note: 10MB = 10485760 bytes. OCR and vision endpoints are exempt for image uploads.

rules.name: Header Validation
rules.description: Require Content-Type header on POST/PUT/PATCH requests to prevent content-type confusion attacks
rules.rationale: All SENTINEL API mutations expect JSON payloads. Missing Content-Type header suggests malformed or malicious requests. Exempt multipart endpoints for file uploads.

cloudflare_config.expression: (http.request.method in {"POST" "PUT" "PATCH"} and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/" and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] contains "application/json") and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] contains "multipart/form-data") and not any(http.request.headers["content-type"][*] contains "text/event-stream") and not http.request.uri.path eq "/api/health")
